scheme_name: Vijayamritham Scheme - Cash Award For Meritorious Children With Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a differently abled student with at least 40% disability.
Must have completed studies in educational institutions within the State of Kerala.
Must have secured at least 60% marks in Arts subjects, 80% marks in Science subjects, and 60% or above in Post‑Graduation and Professional courses.
Must have passed the courses from Government, Aided, or other affiliated institutions (including parallel colleges and distance education centres).
Must have passed the examination in the first attempt.
If two or more students have the same eligibility, priority is given to the student with a higher disability percentage.
benefits_summary: A one‑time cash award of ₹8,000 for degree/equivalent courses and ₹10,000 for post‑graduation or professional courses, along with a certificate and memento.
